what: W10 three-arm factor A/B: admission x parallel decode

arms.reuse: shipped: reuse-signal admission, parallel decode on

design: one build, three arms selected by environment; arm order rotated by round so each arm occupies each slot equally; exact two-sided sign test over per-round ratios within a cell
why_three_arms: the parallel decode is not gated by SCX_ROW_GROUP_ADMIT, so a two-arm admission A/B holds it constant and cannot measure it at all — which is what job 2964125 did
what_this_is_not: not a census measurement, and not a claim about cellset_gather, whose own arm caps its hit rate at 8/64 by construction
arms_verified_by: behaviour, per arm, before every timed invocation
recapture_of: job 2966558 (head c5d8a62a), same script, same three arms, same three cells
why: the first factor capture measured index_plan random-plan gather p50 at 0.952x (1/12, p=0.006) and p99 at 0.937x (2/12, p=0.039) against the serial arm, because every group lookup — including the ~38.5k LRU hits — was dispatched through rayon. The resident-probe hit-path split dispatches only misses; this capture re-measures that latency on the current build.
